title: List HRIDs of components selected in a CmpLib
summary: Checks that the active document is a component library (.CmpLib) and returns the HRID of each component selected in its editor. Shows a safe document-kind check before casting to IComponentLibraryDocument.
phrasings: get selected components in a component library
read item IDs of selected CmpLib components
check if the active document is a CmpLib
list the selection in the component library editor

commands.name: GetSelectedComponents
commands.description: List the HRIDs of the components selected in the active CmpLib
